Plot fishery locations and biological compositions

Source: R/plot_fishery.R
plot_fishery.Rd

A spatial map and true catch versus unweighted measured-length/aged-fish compositions. Counts remain aggregate even for large commercial catches.

plot_fishery(
  sim,
  fishery,
  which_year = sim$years[1],
  which_sim = 1,
  map_by = "operations"
)

Arguments

sim

A simulation returned by sim_fishery() or sim_fisheries().

fishery

One name in sim$fishery$configurations.

which_year

One simulated year.

which_sim

One replicate, or NULL to pool replicates.

map_by

Map "operations", catch numbers ("n"), kilograms ("kg"), or nominal "effort". Zero-catch operations are included.

Value

A Plotly widget. No input tables are modified.

Details

Compositions are percentages within each catch/sample, not weighted estimates of stock composition. Empty catches/samples have zero bars. Effort units are inherited from the selected fishery and are never pooled across gears.

Examples

# plot_fishery(result, "trawl", which_sim = NULL)
